# kinde_environment (Data Source)

Fetches the Kinde environment the provider's M2M application belongs to. Environments cannot be created through the Management API, so this is read-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kinde_environment" "current" {}

output "environment_code" {
  value = data.kinde_environment.current.code
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `code` (String) The unique identifier of the environment, e.g. `production`.
- `color_scheme` (String) The color scheme used for meta tags, based on the theme code.
- `contentsquare_tag_id` (String) The environment's Contentsquare tag ID.
- `created_on` (String) When the environment was created, in ISO 8601 format.
- `custom_domain` (String) The environment's custom domain, if one is set.
- `favicon_fallback` (String) The environment's fallback (PNG) favicon URL.
- `favicon_svg` (String) The environment's SVG favicon URL.
- `google_analytics_tag` (String) The environment's Google Analytics tag.
- `hotjar_site_id` (String) The environment's Hotjar site ID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default environment, typically production.
- `is_live` (Boolean) Whether the environment is live.
- `kinde_domain` (String) The environment's domain on Kinde.
- `logo` (String) The environment's logo URL.
- `logo_dark` (String) The environment's logo URL for dark themes.
- `name` (String) The name of the environment.
- `theme_code` (String) Whether the environment is forced into `light` or `dark` mode, or follows `user_preference`.
